div.div: كِرْشَبٌّ i. q. قِرْشَبٌّ: (K:) or the former signifies Advanced in years, and hard, gross, or coarse: and the latter, a great eater, or voracious. (T.) The ك is said to be substituted for ق, or viciously pronounced for the latter letter. (MF.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
